tasks.design: Configure native car identifiers and service fields in yard asset records {OPS_SYSTEM}. Keep actual counts, movement confirmation, service judgement and full final checking; reduce repeated identifiers before a separate record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Car records may repeat stable identifiers and service wording.
tasks.enabler_now: Native car selection and controlled fields reduce repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Actual car status and repair needs require confirmation.
tasks.human_edge: The operator distinguishes an intended movement from a car actually sent for repair.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native car identifiers and service fields can reduce record repetition; they do not establish actual car movement or service need.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Operator produces/confirms actual counts and condition facts in s1; no free sensor or movement feed is assumed. Existing prefill earns zero new saving.
No repair dispatch or train movement is authorised by this record. Any actual dispatch/send is a separate final-version action with no avoided labour claimed.
research_questions: Can native selection reduce entry after full count/status checking?

incremental.description: Maintain verified car and service fields.

tasks.altitude: Actual monitoring and engine judgement remain human.

tasks.design: Retain actual emergency assessment, equipment preparation, final placement checking and physical warning placement. No required record, report, repeated lookup or digital send is established in this warning-placement task, so no administrative saving is invented.

tasks.human_edge: The operator adapts protection to changing real track conditions.
tasks.altitude: Actual emergency warning protection remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: emergency warning-device placement is physical work requiring actual conditions and procedure.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Existing final placement check serves the gate without added approval work. Each actual changed placement returns to s3/s4; plan does not prove warnings were placed or observed.

Warning recipients may be internal or other operators: use actual organisation boundary for communication authority. No software action proposed. Any actual required subsequent incident record or send is separately mapped and gated with no saving assumed.
